Api.showWidget: Shows one widget and marks it forced-by-eventmap.
Api.show: jQuery-level show of one widget by id (does not mark it forced-by-eventmap).
Api.hide: jQuery-level hide of one widget by id (does not mark it forced-by-eventmap).
Api.hideWidget: Hides one widget and marks it forced-by-eventmap.
Api.toggleWidgets: Toggles the visibility of multiple widgets by id.
Api.toggleWidget: Toggles one widget's visibility and marks it forced-by-eventmap.
Api.fadeOutWidget: Fades out and hides one widget (300ms animation).
Api.changeSegmentedControlSelection: Marks one segmented-control tab as selected and deselects its sibling tabs.
Api.resetRadioButtons: Clears the selected state of a radio-button group.
Api.scrollTo: Smoothly scrolls the page to a widget, by id or as [id, verticalOffset].
Api.jumpTo: Instantly jumps the browser to an anchor (#id), no animation.
Api.openPage: Navigates to another Studio page by its page widget id.
Api.backToMain: Navigates to the application's configured main page.
Api.openPrevPage: Navigates back to the previously visited page, if any.
Api.openPrevPageWithState: Navigates back to the previous page, restoring its saved filters/selection state.
Api.openPageWithWaitingForEvent: Waits for a named event to fire, then navigates to a page: ["eventName", "pageId"].
Api.openPageAndScrollToSection: Navigates to a page and scrolls to a section on it once loaded: [pageId, sectionId].
Api.openPageWithWaitingForEventAndScroll: Waits for a named event, navigates to a page, then scrolls to a section: ["eventName", "pageId", "section"].
Api.openPageWithState: Navigates to a page, restoring its saved filters/selection state if any exists.
Api.openPageWithStateAndScrollToSection: Navigates to a page with saved state, scrolls to a section, and force-refreshes any extra widgets listed: [pageId, sectionId, ...widgetIds].
Api.openPageWithStateAndWaitingForEvent: Waits for a named event, then navigates to a page with saved state and refreshes extra widgets: ["eventName", "pageId", ...widgetIds].
Api.openPageWithStateAndWaitingForEventA: Waits for a named event, navigates with saved state, scrolls to a section, and refreshes extra widgets: ["eventName", "pageId", "section", ...widgetIds].
Api.removeWidgetValues: Resets an array of widgets to their default/empty value.
Api.skip: Identity pass-through - returns its argument unchanged (placeholder/no-op action).
Api.removePageValues: Resets the value of every widget on a page.
Api.removeValuesRecursively: Recursively resets a widget subtree's values (internal helper for removePageValues).
Api.showToolTipsChanged: Shows or hides every info-button tooltip, based on the current ShowTooltips value.
Api.refresh: Alias for forceRefresh - re-renders a widget from the server.
Api.forceRefresh: Re-renders one widget (or an array of widget ids) from the server.
Api.forceRefreshWithoutLoader: Re-renders a widget from the server without showing the loading spinner.
Api.forceRefreshWidgets: Re-renders multiple widgets from the server in parallel.
Api.forceRefreshWithDelay: Refreshes a widget after waiting a delay: [widgetId, delayMs].
Api.refreshWithStateAndTimeout: Refreshes a widget with its state preserved, after waiting a delay: [widgetId, delayMs].
Api.refreshWithWaitingForEvents: Refreshes a widget only once every named event in the list has fired: [widgetId, ...eventNames, callback?].
Api.renderPage: Fully re-renders a page widget's HTML and rebinds its events (heavier than forceRefresh).
Api.forceRefreshWithState: Re-renders a widget from the server while preserving its current state/selection.
Api.goToUrl: Navigates the browser to an external URL in the same tab.
Api.goToUrlNewTab: Opens an external URL in a new browser tab.
Api.showPopup: Shows a simple modal message popup with the given text.
Api.changeSystemValue: Sets a systemValue to true/false based on whether another systemValue equals 1: [targetName, sourceSystemValueName].
Api.addSystemValue: Sets a systemValue to a literal value: [name, value].
Api.addSystemValueByVal: Copies the current value of one systemValue into another by name: [targetName, sourceSystemValueName].
Api.addGridTableSystemValue: Extracts one GridTable cell into a new systemValue: [name, gridSystemValueName, rowIndex, colIndex].
Api.addGridTableCurrentRowSystemValue: Extracts a cell from a GridTable's currently active row into a new systemValue: [name, widgetId, colIndex].
Api.increaseWidgetValue: Increments a numeric widget's value by a step, capped at a max: [widgetId, step, maxSystemValue].
Api.decreaseWidgetValue: Decrements a numeric widget's value by a step, floored at a min: [widgetId, step, minSystemValue].
Api.resetWidgetValue: Resets a widget's value to a given default: [widgetId, defaultValue].
Api.setWidgetValue: Sets a widget's value from another systemValue's current value: [widgetId, sourceSystemValueName].
Api.removePageState: Clears the saved filters/selection state for the listed page ids.
Api.openPopup: Opens a popup widget by id, anchoring it to the triggering element when the popup opens on click. Prefer Utils.openPopup(id, ctx) for widget-event behaviors - it resolves the event/element automatically.
Api.openPopupWithTimeout: Opens a popup after waiting a delay: [popupId, timeoutMs].
Api.togglePopup: Opens a popup if closed / closes it if open, anchoring as needed. Prefer Utils.togglePopup(id, ctx) for widget-event behaviors.
Api.closePopup: Closes an open popup by id. Prefer Utils.closePopup(id, ctx) for widget-event behaviors.
Api.toggleInfoWidget: Toggles an info popup, feeding it data and optionally refreshing other widgets while it stays open: [popupId, dataObject, ...refreshWidgetIds].
Api.pasteToGridTableText: Pastes clipboard content into the GridTable text cell that was last right-clicked.
Api.checkTIResponseStatus: Runs one of two callback functions depending on whether a TM1 process response succeeded or was aborted.
Api.conditionalHorizontalTableEventHandl: Runs conditional rule actions (see conditionalExecution) based on the horizontal table's currently selected row.
Api.conditionalGridTablePopup: Runs conditional rule actions (see conditionalExecution) based on the GridTable cell under the popup trigger.
Api.conditionalExecution: Evaluates a list of {conditionKey, actions} rules against a cell and runs the first matching rule's actions (or the 'else' rule).
Api.increasePage: Advances a paged GridTable to its next page.
Api.decreasePage: Moves a paged GridTable back to its previous page.
Api.jumpToFirstPage: Jumps a paged GridTable to its first page.
Api.jumpToLastPage: Jumps a paged GridTable to its last page.
Api.copyChangedCells: Internal: snapshots a paged GridTable's currently rendered cell HTML before switching pages.
Api.executeRequest: Sends a pending write request (e.g. an edited GridTable cell) to the server for the given event map id.
Api.executeQueryRequest: Sends a read/query request (e.g. MDX) to the server and loads the result into the widget.
Api.removeSliders: Resets the internal slider-widget registry (used when rebuilding a page that contains sliders).
Api.updateContent: Updates a widget's content in place without a full re-render.
Api.updateWidgetsContent: Updates the content of multiple widgets in place.
Api.updateContentWithoutLoader: Same as updateContent but without showing the loading spinner.
Api.updateWidgetsContentWithoutLoader: Updates multiple widgets' content in place without the loading spinner.
Api.refreshWithWaitingForEventWithoutLoa: Same as refreshWithWaitingForEvent but never shows the loading spinner: [widgetId, eventName, callback?].
Api.refreshWithWaitingForEvent: Refreshes a widget once a named event fires: [widgetId, eventName, withLoader?, callback?].
Api.goToStartPage: Navigates to the application's configured start/login page.
Api.triggerWidgetEvent: Manually fires a widget's own event handler for the given event name (e.g. simulates a click programmatically).
Api.navigateAppTo: Navigates to the page derived from a browser sub-path/URL - used for deep-linking into the app.
